result.edit: The failure occurs when checking a group starting with 000000. The state machine incorrectly transitions from sf4 to s1 regardless of the input data value, causing incorrect classification of the next group's first bit. The change makes sf4's transition depend on the current data input, preserving the group boundary detection. This should fix the mismatch observed at cycle 12 where the output was 00 but should have been 01 for the group 000000.
